method.formula: annual revenue = monthly query volume x capture rate x redemption rate x payout x 12
method.capture_rate: 0.10 (assumption: share of searches where Refer Labs' code is the one seen, for a new page reaching page 1 within 6 months)
method.redemption_rate: 0.05 (assumption: share of those who then buy with the code)
method.anchor_code: Moshy code queries = 100 searches/month (Search Console: 106 impressions in 28 days to 17 Sep 2026 at avg position 5.7; 255 in 90 days from 20 Jun; band 85 to 115)
method.anchor_review: Moshy review/vs/legit queries = 350 searches/month (Search Console: 347 impressions in 28 days, 978 in 90 days, avg position 8.2; a floor, since page-1 positions 8 to 10 under-count)
method.scaling: Google Trends AU, past 12 months, weekly: brand-name interest relative to 'moshy' (14 batches, every batch includes 'moshy' and 'marley spoon'; the marley/moshy ratio held at 4.15 to 4.53 across batches). Code intensity measured where the brand's code family ('<brand> code + <brand> discount') was non-zero in 26+ of 53 weeks, relative to the median of those brands (0.74, Moshy assumed median). Review family not measured (Trends rate-limited after ~30 requests); review volume = 350 x brand ratio.
method.uncertainty: Measured code intensity: x0.5 to x2. Unmeasured: x0.33 to x3, or a range from the sparse Trends reading to Moshy-like intensity. All volumes are estimates, not keyword-tool figures.
method.calibration_note: On the anchor the formula predicts about 7.7 sales/month for Moshy plus Mosh (code + review searches x 0.5%), against about 69 transactions/month observed across Moshy, Mosh and Juniper. The observed business runs roughly 9x the formula, because revenue comes from code display on category and comparison queries and AI answers, not brand queries. The multiplier is applied to no row; it would scale every row equally and does not change the order.

cf_clickless_census.definition: "A form of tracking that does not require a click to be the source of the transaction. Uses exclusive coupon code assigned to individual affiliate to match the transaction to the affiliate, instead of a click." https://help.commissionfactory.com/clickless-tracking
cf_clickless_census.caveat: The badge shows the advertiser's integration can do it; the advertiser still has to assign a code to us (https://help.commissionfactory.com/clickless-codes).
